title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Digital Inventory of Cultural Heritage & Traditional Knowledge: Case for Indonesian Open Digital Library of Culture
abstract: arXiv:2609.08105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Indonesian Digital Library of Culture (Perpustakaan Digital Budaya Indonesia, PDBI; budaya-indonesia.org) is a participatory platform that has collected tens of thousands of entries on Nusantara cultural heritage through public contribution since 2007. Manual contribution faces three structural barriers: coverage (knowledge is scattered across languages and sites), integrity (open sources mix authentic documentation with noise), and completeness (subjects are recorded but their data remain shallow). This paper presents a methodological framework for autonomous, AI-based harvesting of cultural knowledge from the open web, designed to expand corpus coverage while intensifying per-entry data depth. translated_title: 人工智能辅助的文化遗产与传统知识数字清点：印度尼西亚开放数字文化图书馆案例
translated_abstract: 印度尼西亚数字文化图书馆（Perpustakaan Digital Budaya Indonesia，PDBI；budaya-indonesia.org）是一个参与式平台，自2007年以来通过公众贡献收集了数万条关于努山塔拉文化遗产的条目。人工贡献面临三个结构性障碍：覆盖面（知识分散在不同语言和站点之间）、完整性（开放来源将真实的文献记录与噪音混杂在一起）以及完备性（主题虽有记录但数据仍然浅薄）。本文提出了一个从开放网络中自主地、基于人工智能采集文化知识的方法论框架，旨在扩大语料库覆盖面的同时加深每个条目的数据深度。该方法论被组织为五个阶段的经济漏斗：聚焦式爬取、多语言提取与规范化、带分块的向量编码、智能体决策以及幂等发布，并遵循确定性原则……
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于人工智能的五阶段方法论框架（聚焦爬取、多语言提取规范化、向量编码、智能体决策、幂等发布），用于从开放网络自主采集文化知识，从而扩展印度尼西亚数字文化图书馆的语料覆盖面并加深条目数据深度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an AI-based five-stage methodological framework (focused crawling, multilingual extraction, vector encoding, agentic decision-making, and idempotent publication) for autonomously harvesting cultural knowledge from the open web to expand corpus coverage and deepen per-entry data depth for the Indonesian Digital Library of Culture.
